items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Xavier Cugat in the context of a business negotiation ('I did a trick') and historical precedence regarding the conga drum ('Before we did, Xavier Cugat'), but does not describe a personal relationship, collaboration, or direct interaction beyond this professional/historical

ctx.x: He just - I-didn't bother because I wanted to get at him; as a matter of fact, I did a trick. He had - his dance was postponed so he say: "Gee, my dance was postponed, I want to play here this coming Saturday". I said, why don't we put the two bands together? He said: "No, no, no, no, if you put your band, you are responsible the expenses your band and I responsible for mine, so if you want to play together you got to pay for your band." I said, okay, so we went together to the, to the printer and I say, in order…

they was fed up so when we played, we were the first ones to start. We start with "Intermezzo" and the "Muerto se fue de Rumba". We were rehearsong with a good sound, so imagine!, we got there with uniforms, because everything was prepared to giving a good impression.
